name: Dragon Will
beast: Mana Dragon (Sylvia, who gave her will to Arthur)
source: CANON (wiki page): a mana beast of A Class or higher can pass on its will; Sylvia gave hers to Arthur; Arthur as a child felt pain from it so it must be trained; Acquire borrows strengths (+ common markings), Integrate truly uses the abilities with a real body transformation. CANON ADDENDUM 2 (owner): it is the Dragon's Will, the will of an Asuran entity, given by Sylvia to Arthur; Arthur also has an Equals-Contract bond with her daughter Sylvie (a separate mechanic, not modelled here). SNIPPET (search digests, medium confidence): Acquire = Static Void (aether freezes time, short and costly), Integrate = Realmheart (white hair, lavender eyes, gold runes on arms and under the eyes, sees mana and aether, gravity/space). DESIGN: the lavender-aether palette, the dragon-humanoid body, every number, the breath pulse and the skill moves. Style idea: partial piece in Acquire -> full armoured form in Integrate (design only, not TBATE canon; owner request).
lore: The Dragon's Will, an Asuran dragon's will of the Indrath line (Aether) that Sylvia gave to Arthur. A holder first borrows its grip on aether (Static Void); only a trained one becomes the Realmheart dragon-humanoid.
untrained: Canon: Arthur felt pain from Sylvia's will. DESIGN: the highest strain of any will (acquire 0.28/s, integrate 1.4/s); an untrained holder's screen shudders, aether backlash burns mana and hearts whenever Static Void or the breath is cast past the trained level. CANON ADDENDUM 2: the will lies dormant in the holder's mana core until it is forcefully awakened (a flame sparked in the core); if the holder cannot suppress and balance it, the clashing energies wreck body and core and can kill (design: strain climbs fast, backlash damage, forced cancel at the cap); mastery means training both the holder's own core and the beast core, best taught by the beast itself. This will summons no beasts or hordes.

name: Elderwood Guardian Will
beast: Elderwood Guardian (corrupted S-class plant beast, centaur-like body of entangled vines)
source: CANON (wiki page): Tessia Eralith holds the corrupted Elderwood Guardian's will; even trained she needed more training to master it or it would overwhelm her; Acquire borrows strengths, Integrate is a true transformation. SNIPPET (search digests, medium confidence): the Guardian is S-class (so minRank S); forged tamer (core absorbed); Acquire = thin emerald aura like a second skin, bursting out under the feet through the grass, summoning and controlling many vines; Integrate = thick coiling emerald aura, pale skin, forest-green hair, glowing turquoise eyes with markings, aura shaped into dual blades; Vritra-corrupted, half power at first; no heal or ward is attested. DESIGN (ours): the treant-beastman body, every number and move name. CANON ADDENDUM 2 applied: only an A-class or higher beast leaves an intact will (rare); the will lies dormant in the holder's core and must be forcefully awakened (a flame sparked in the host's core); mastery = train the holder's own core AND the inherited beast core, best teacher is the beast itself; Beast Tamers command no armies (no summoning of several beasts). Style idea: partial piece in Acquire -> full armoured form in Integrate (design only, not TBATE canon; owner request).
lore: The will of a Vritra-corrupted, Hamadryad-like grove guardian. It lends vines and emerald aura, but it pushes back: a holder who is not trained enough is overwhelmed.
untrained: Hardest will to control in the roster. Canon: even a trained holder must train more or the corrupted will overwhelms them. DESIGN: highest strain of every will (Acquire 0.28, Integrate 1.4); past a strain threshold black blight veins climb the body, abilities cost extra strain and the vines turn on the holder (a short self-root); the awakening needs an outside flame in the core and a forced or neglected one can kill the host.

Panel: dark panther beastman (cat ears, claws, whip tail, ragged shadow edges, glowing eyes, digitigrade crouch). SNIPPET (canon_dossier 2.3, medium): Acquire = peak speed and reflexes, Integrate = black-panther look with superhuman strength, anime darkness shroud. Ability numbers and ids are DESIGN. STYLE: acquire/integrate follow the style idea: partial piece -> full armoured form (design, not TBATE canon).
lore: A panther of moonless dark that hushes wind and sound until it is only a rumour; the holder first borrows its reflexes, then becomes the silence it hunts in.
untrained: An untrained holder's own shadow tears loose in pain: ragged shadow flickers off the body, hearing drops out in short bursts and every dash adds extra strain; the form burns mana so fast that an unbalanced will can wreck the core and kill the host. The will lies dormant in the core until it is forcibly awakened; training both the holder's own core and the beast core is the cure.

name: Lion Will
beast: World Lion (A-class pride king)
source: DESIGN (ours): CANON ADDENDUM 2 says Curtis Glayder has a BOND (not a will) with the World Lion cub Grawder, so a Lion Will is not canon; this is our own pride-king lion will built on the wiki rules (A-class, borrowed poise and stare in Acquire, the world-shaking howl and lion-humanoid body in Integrate). CANON ADDENDUM 2: the will lies dormant in the holder's mana core until it is forcefully awakened (a flame sparked in the core); if the holder cannot suppress and balance it, the clashing energies wreck body and core and can kill (design: strain climbs fast, backlash damage, forced cancel at the cap); mastery means training both the holder's own core and the beast core, best taught by the beast itself. name: Crested Boar Will
beast: Crested Boar Elder (A-class highland tusker)
source: DESIGN (ours): no canon beast on the wiki page; built on the wiki rules (A-class, borrowed hide and charge in Acquire, true avalanche gore in Integrate). Style idea: partial piece in Acquire -> full armoured form in Integrate (design only, not TBATE canon; owner request).
lore: The will of a highland tusker so old its bristle crest has turned to stone: it does not dodge, it walks through the blow and gores.

This will summons no beasts or hordes.

name: Wind-Skimmer Raptor Will
beast: Gale Skimmer Elder (A-class sky raptor)

lore: The will of an elder raptor that skims the top of the gale: it never lands hard, fades into clouds and falls on prey from the wind.
untrained: An untrained holder is thrown by their own wind: the body wobbles in mid-air, falls are not cushioned as expected and strain climbs with every dash and dive. name: Flame-Serpent Will
beast: Flame-Serpent Elder (A-class cinder coil)

name: Scylla and Charybdis Will
beast: Scylla and Charybdis, the Strait Pair
source: DESIGN (ours): Greek myth pair (Scylla: six dog-heads snatching sailors off the cliff; Charybdis: a whirlpool that swallows ships), built on the wiki rules (A-class). STYLE: acquire/integrate follow the style idea: partial piece -> full armoured form (design, not TBATE canon).
lore: On opposite sides of the narrow strait: Scylla with six snapping dog heads on the cliff, Charybdis the whirlpool beneath.
untrained: An untrained holder is torn two ways: the heads snap at the holder's own shoulders, the whirlpool drags at the legs and strain builds whenever both halves act together. CANON ADDENDUM 2: the will lies dormant in the holder's mana core until it is forcefully awakened (a flame sparked in the core); if the holder cannot suppress and balance it, the clashing energies wreck body and core and can kill (design: strain climbs fast, backlash damage, forced cancel at the cap); mastery means training both the holder's own core and the beast core, best taught by the beast itself. This will summons no beasts or hordes.

name: Typhon Will
beast: Typhon, the Deadliest Monster
source: DESIGN: Typhon from Greek myth (Father of Monsters, a hundred dragon heads, fire in the eyes, many voices, vipers at the thighs, fought Zeus with storm and fire). Not on the page or in the snippets; page rules only. CANON ADDENDUM 2 applied: only an A-class or higher beast leaves an intact will (rare); the will lies dormant in the holder's core and must be forcefully awakened (a flame sparked in the host's core); mastery = train the holder's own core AND the inherited beast core, best teacher is the beast itself; Beast Tamers command no armies (no summoning of several beasts). STYLE: acquire/integrate follow the style idea: partial piece -> full armoured form (design, not TBATE canon).
lore: Typhon, Father of Monsters: a hundred dragon heads that roar with every voice, fire in the eyes and vipers at the thighs.
untrained: An untrained holder is blasted by their own thunder voice: ringing ears, scorching fever and uncontrolled flashes of lightning that hit the holder first. Canon: a will that is not suppressed or balanced disrupts body and mana core and can eventually kill the holder, so the first Awakening (forced, a spark in the core) is the most dangerous moment and training both cores is the cure.

name: Yamata no Orochi Will
beast: Yamata no Orochi, the Eight-Headed Dragon
source: DESIGN: Yamata no Orochi from Japanese myth (eight heads and tails, eyes red as winter cherries, a flood-bringer, drowned in sake). Not on the pasted page. STYLE: acquire/integrate follow the style idea: partial piece -> full armoured form (design, not TBATE canon).

untrained: An untrained holder is torn by eight conflicting urges: heads of fever, flooding thirst and a drunken stagger that drops their guard. The will lay dormant until forcibly awakened; if the holder cannot balance it the clash tears at body and core and can kill, and only training the holder's own core and the beast core (best teacher: the beast itself) tames it.
